React Frontend (Vite + Dashboard)
ESP32 Device & Physical Sensors
MQTT Broker (EMQX Cloud MQTTS / Mosquitto)
FastAPI Backend & Ingestion Pipeline
Edge Impulse TinyML & Rules Engine
MongoDB (TimeSeries, Auth, Audits & WO)
SECTION A: AUTHENTICATION, ROLE VERIFICATION & DASHBOARD ACCESS
SECTION B: PHYSICAL MOTOR SELECTION, SENSOR CALIBRATION & MQTT CONNECTION
SECTION C: SENSOR SAMPLING, INTEGRITY CHECK, TINYML INFERENCE & TELEMETRY ASSEMBLY
SECTION D: BACKEND INGESTION, SCHEMA CONTRACT & IDEMPOTENT DEDUPLICATION
SECTION E: MULTI-TIER MOTOR HEALTH, TINYML INFERENCE EVALUATION & ALERT RULES
SECTION F: SCOPED WEBSOCKET HUB BROADCAST & LIVE DASHBOARD UPDATES
SECTION G: WORK ORDER MAINTENANCE LIFECYCLE & IMMUTABLE AUDIT TRAIL
SECTION H: CONTINUOUS MONITORING FEEDBACK LOOP & GRACEFUL TERMINATION

Open MotorGuard Web Application (SPA via Browser)
Render Login Interface (Prompt for Credentials)
Enter Username & Password (Admin / Manager / Tech / Operator)
Submit Login Request POST /api/v1/auth/login
Validate Credentials against MongoDB users collection (bcrypt)
Credentials Valid?
Return 401 Unauthorized (Invalid credentials error)
Display Authentication Error Notification (Toast Alert)
Retry Login?
Issue Signed JWT Access Token (Contains user_id, role, assigned_sites/motors)
Store Token, Authorize Session & Render Scoped Role Dashboard
Select Monitored Motor Asset (e.g., MTR-775-001) in UI
Fetch Motor Metadata, Assigned ESP32 & Operational Thresholds
Query motors & thresholds collections via REST API
Read Sensor Calibration & Target Envelope Profile
Power On ESP32 Microcontroller & Initialize Dual-I2C Buses
Initialize Sensors: • ADXL345 (Bus 0: 21/22) • SH1106 OLED (Bus 1: 32/33) • DHT11 (GPIO 4), ACS712 (GPIO 34)
Perform Current Zero Calibration (Sample idle ADC offset, Vref = 1.65V)
Attempt MQTT Broker Connection (MQTTS Port 8883 / TLS 1.2+ / certs)
Connection Available?
Log Failure to OLED Screen & Execute Exponential Backoff
NOTE: Offline local flash buffering is marked PLANNED / UNIMPLEMENTED in firmware v1.0.1. Firmware displays offline status & loops reconnection.
Establish Session, Subscribe to Topics & Start 100 Hz Sampling Timer
Acquire Synchronized Sensor Data: • Temp & Humidity (DHT11, paced >=2s) • Armature Current (ACS712, 100 mV/A) • 3-Axis Accel (ADXL345, 100 Hz buffer)
Validate Raw Sensor Readings (Check NaN, I2C Bus Ack & Range)
Sensor Data Valid?
Record Sensor Diagnostic: • Set status: DISCONNECTED / UNAVAILABLE • Assign reading: null (NEVER 0.0)
STRICT ZERO vs. UNAVAILABLE: Missing readings produce null. De-energized idle motor produces 0.0A. Prevents distortion of fleet metrics.
Set status to OK, Subtract Gravity Mean & Compute Vibration RMS / Peak Shock
Execute Edge Impulse TinyML Classifier (Model: 128-sample Accel Frame @ 100 Hz Outputs: healthy, warning, critical probs)
Assemble Contract Telemetry Payload v1.0.0 (schema_ver, event_id: UUIDv4, device_id, motor_id, source, seq, timestamp, sensors, status, inference)
Publish QoS 1 Telemetry Packet to Topic: motorguard/{device_id}/telemetry
MQTT Broker Receives Packet & Forwards to Subscribed Ingestion Topic
Deliver MQTT Message to FastAPI Background Subscriber Thread (_on_message)
Validate Pydantic TelemetryMessage Contract & Match Payload device_id with Topic (MG-F04)
Schema Contract & Identity Valid?
Reject Ingestion, Increment Error Counter & Log Spoofing / Malformed Warning
Query Device Registry to Verify Motor Assignment & Check Liveness Eligibility
Device Registered & Motor Assigned?
Drop Telemetry from Unregistered or Mismatched Device-Motor Pair
Stamp server_received_at & Attempt Atomic Insert in MongoDB
Enforce Compound Unique Index: (device_id: 1, event_id: 1)
Event Unique?
Catch DuplicateKeyError & Safely Drop Duplicate Event
Persist Telemetry Document in MongoDB telemetry Collection (Indexed & TTL-managed)
Update Device & Motor Liveness Status (Heartbeat timestamp in registry)

Deterministic Physical Safety Rules: • Hard Overcurrent (>= 4.5A CRITICAL) • Overcurrent (>= 4.0A CRIT / >= 3.4A WARN) • Overtemp (>= 75°C CRIT / >= 50°C WARN) • Vibration RMS (>= 0.4g CRIT / >= 0.1g WARN) • Vibration Peak (>= 0.8g CRIT / >= 0.35g WARN)
Edge Impulse TinyML Evaluation: • Confidence thresholding (>= 50%) • ML Classes: healthy, warning, critical • Model diagnostic error detection
Sensor Availability Checks: • Temperature DISCONNECTED/OUT_OF_RANGE • Current sensor DISCONNECTED/UNAVAILABLE • Accelerometer I2C bus failure • Zero-calibration UNCALIBRATED
Synthesize Motor Health State: Enforce Strict Safety Rule Precedence: Healthy ML NEVER suppresses Physical Trip!
RULE PRECEDENCE (MG-F06): Physical safety thresholds take absolute priority over TinyML. Even if ML model predicts 'healthy', any current/vibration limit violation triggers a CRITICAL alert.
Determine Motor Condition?
Create / Update CRITICAL Alert (HARD_OVERCURRENT / THRESHOLD_VIOLATION or CRITICAL_INFERENCE_FAULT)
Create / Update WARNING Alert (WARNING_INFERENCE_ANOMALY or THRESHOLD_WARNING with hysteresis)
Confirm Healthy Operating Status & Auto-Normalize Resolved Active Alerts
Trigger INFERENCE_DIAGNOSTIC_FAILURE (Never falsely declares motor healthy)
Trigger SENSOR_DISCONNECTED / UNCALIBRATED Diagnostic Alert with Config Snapshot
Record Alert Lifecycle Event & Config Snapshot into MongoDB audit_logs & audit_events
Push Telemetry & Alert Events to WebSocketManager Hub (ws_manager)
Enforce RBAC & Scoping Filter: • Admin: Fleet-wide visibility • Manager: Scoped to assigned sites • Tech/Op: Scoped to assigned motors
WEBSOCKET RBAC (MG-F01): Login does NOT grant fleet-wide stream! is_authorized_for_event() inspects each connected socket's user role & assignments.
Receive Live WebSocket Stream & Update React Dashboard UI (Realtime)
Render Telemetry Graphs (Chart.js/Canvas), Condition Badges, Shock Trends & Alarms
View Updated Fleet Status, Acknowledge Active Warnings or Report Malfunctions
Maintenance Required?
Create Work Order (POST /api/v1/work-orders) Title, Priority, Motor ID, Linked Alert
Assign to Technician (Status: Assigned) & Record WORK_ORDER_CREATED in audit_logs
Technician Reviews Alert Diagnostics & Accepts Task (Status: Accepted)
Update Status to In Progress & Record WORK_ORDER_ACCEPTED Audit
Technician Inspects Motor, Replaces Defective Component & Submits Resolution
Resolve Work Order (Status: Resolved) Diagnosis, Actions, Parts, Downtime Mins
Auto-Resolve Linked Alert in alerts col & Append Final WORK_ORDER_RESOLVED Audit
Monitoring State?
Graceful Shutdown: Close WebSocket Session, Disconnect MQTT Client & De-energize Sampling Timer
